benchmark_suites:
CREATE TABLE benchmark_suites (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	repo_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	test_coverage_pct FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	cyclomatic_complexity FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	sec_vulnerabilities_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	ai_generated_probability FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	execution_time_ms INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	suite_log_output TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (repo_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repo_id) REFERENCES candidate_repos (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
candidate_repos:
CREATE TABLE candidate_repos (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	candidate_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_github_handle VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_avatar_url VARCHAR(512), 
	repo_url VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, 
	repo_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	target_role VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	branch VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	commit_sha VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	language VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	submitted_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
code_evaluation_results:
CREATE TABLE code_evaluation_results (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	repo_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	composite_health_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	architecture_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	concurrency_safety_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	maintainability_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	anti_cheat_confidence FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	summary_verdict TEXT NOT NULL, 
	rubric_breakdown JSON NOT NULL, 
	flagged_anomalies JSON NOT NULL, 
	recommended_defense_topics JSON NOT NULL, 
	evaluated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (repo_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repo_id) REFERENCES candidate_repos (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
job_leads:
CREATE TABLE job_leads (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	raw_post_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role_title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	company_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	company_stage VARCHAR(100), 
	comp_min FLOAT, 
	comp_max FLOAT, 
	comp_currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	equity_note VARCHAR(120), 
	tech_stack JSON NOT NULL, 
	location_mode VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	clearance_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_hiring BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	match_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	urgency_tier VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	contact_anchor VARCHAR(255), 
	enrichment_metadata JSON NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (raw_post_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(raw_post_id) REFERENCES raw_posts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
lead_embeddings:
CREATE TABLE lead_embeddings (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	lead_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	embedding VECTOR(768), 
	text_content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(lead_id) REFERENCES job_leads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
lead_embeddings__indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_lead_embeddings_lead_id ON lead_embeddings (lead_id)
leaderboard_scores:
CREATE TABLE leaderboard_scores (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	candidate_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	candidate_avatar_url VARCHAR(512), 
	candidate_handle VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	target_role VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL, 
	repo_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	code_health_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	voice_defense_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	composite_percentile FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	rank_tier VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	status_tag VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	recorded_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (session_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES voice_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
outreach_drafts:
CREATE TABLE outreach_drafts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	lead_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tone VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	pitch_subject VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	generated_pitch TEXT NOT NULL, 
	candidate_profile_context TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	model_version VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	prompt_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	completion_tokens INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(lead_id) REFERENCES job_leads (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
raw_posts:
CREATE TABLE raw_posts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	platform VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	author_handle VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	author_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	author_avatar_url VARCHAR(512), 
	raw_content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	source_channel VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	ingested_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	is_processed BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
raw_posts__indexes: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_raw_posts_external_id ON raw_posts (external_id)
voice_sessions:
CREATE TABLE voice_sessions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	repo_id UUID, 
	candidate_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	session_status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	completed_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	duration_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	technical_depth_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	clarity_articulation_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	architecture_defense_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	final_composite_score FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	defense_verdict VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	transcript_turns JSON NOT NULL, 
	key_takeaways JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(repo_id) REFERENCES candidate_repos (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
